Description:
Built in the late 1860s the Inn was once home to the local plantation doctor and his family.  The home and the grounds still carry the vintage feel and the original architecture of old Hawaii.  Plantation era is about to come to an end here in the islands of Hawaii and Maui will be closing the last sugar plantation at the end of 2016.  

Haiku Inn, speaks of that era of missionary families, colonial homes, and plantation life.  We maintain the feeling for a reason, as there are very few locations in the state where you can see yet experience a home of this era.   

We are centrally located on the North Shore with a brief walk to restaurants, markets, shops and services. We lovingly restored the old home and continue to our stewardship daily.  Come experience the days of gone by, and the real meaning of Aloha and the Hawaiian spirit.  Rest and relax in an atmosphere of peace and calm, yet close to Paia, Makawao and the big surf beaches. All of Maui is easy access really and we are right off Hana Hwy.  We are about an hours drive to the summit for sunrise, minutes to bike tours, ziplines, horseback rides, sea turtle viewing and even waterfalls with swimming holes.  Mauis best! Nestled in the historic plantation town of Haiku, Hawaii, this charming guest house offers an on-site garden where guests can relax and enjoy fresh growing fruits. Free Wi-Fi is provided in the lobby.

Built in the 1870s for a pineapple plantation doctor, this historic home provides guest accommodations in a bed and breakfast setting. All rooms at Haiku Plantation Inn are furnished with an eclectic mix of antique pieces, Hawaiian quilts, and authentic Hawaiian art. Each room is equipped with an en suite bathroom.

The guest lounge area boasts tropically themed furnishings, travel guides and reading materials, a flat-screen TV, and an audio and video library. Guests can enjoy views of the garden and its century-old trees out on the spacious patio.

A complimentary continental breakfast consisting of a variety of selections such as baked goods and pastries, fresh fruits, cereals, yogurts, and jams is served daily. An all-day tea counter is also available for guests at Haiku Plantation Inn.

The surrounding countryside includes several attractions, such as cane fields, the last pineapple plantation, and organic farms. Hana Highway, which offers a scenic drive along the shore, is just a 2-minute drive from the guest house, and Haleakala National Park is a 45-minute drive. Kahului Airport is a 24-minute drive away. Description:
The Wild Ginger Inn Hotel & Hostel has an old fashion country atmosphere that reflects its era. Originally, the building was a 1920s sugar cane plantation workers house. In the 1950s it was converted into an Inn with 27 private bedrooms with baths. In keeping with the original look and feel, youll experience the Hawaiian laid back, simple living style with a relaxing ocean view. Although we have not completely updated to join the 21st century, some modern day comforts have been provided in a few upgraded rooms such as a cable TV, mini refrigerator, and microwave. A microwave and small fridge are provided in all rooms at the Wild Ginger Inn Hotel and Hostel. Some rooms boast either garden or sea views.

Description:
HotelDescription#Located on the eastern shore of the Garden Isle of Kauai, the resort has an exclusive sandy beach and is a hideaway surrounded by lush gardens. It is also centrally located, with Poipu to the south and Napali Coast to the north giving easy access to all of Kauai's activities and sights. Shops and dining are within walking distance of the Coconut Plantation Marketplace. These apartments are the perfect starting point to explore the beauty of Kauai with Wailua Falls and Fern Grotto just a few minutes drive away.

The resort is the ultimate Kauai beachfront rental property, conveniently located yet absolutely private. The spacious 1- and 2-bedroom apartments are set on Wailua Bay on the island of Kauai. The complex has a total of 18 units and includes a lobby and parking facilities.

The roomy 1- or 2-bedroom Kauai condo rentals are individually furnished and feel like the islands. Each one of these gorgeous Kauai condo rentals comes with a full kitchen, wet bar, cable TV and VCR. There is no air conditioning but ceiling fans are provided. An en suite bathroom with hairdryer features, as does a direct dial telephone, radio, kitchen, fridge, cooker, microwave, tea/coffee making facilities and an ironing set. The balconies overlook the lush gardens and the sandy beachfront.

Guests are offered a variety of activities including snorkelling, diving, kayaking and sailing. Guests can also soak up the Hawaiian sun on the sundeck, walk to Plantation Marketplace for a bite to eat and some shopping, play golf at one of the many world-class golf courses in the area, or swim in the saltwater pool. A solarium also features. There is a barbeque area on site.

Exit the Lihue Airport and turn right at the first traffic signal onto Kapule Highway (Hwy)/Hwy 51. Continue on Hwy 51 until it intersects with Kuhio Hwy/Hwy 56. Continue on Kuhio Hwy/Hwy 56 as it crosses the Waialua River Bridge. Turn right before the Shell Service Station onto Papaloa Road. Turn right into the resort.

Description:
HotelDescription#Located on the eastern shore of the Garden Isle of Kauai, the resort has an exclusive sandy beach and is a hideaway surrounded by lush gardens. It is also centrally located, with Poipu to the south and Napali Coast to the north giving easy access to all of Kauai's activities and sights. Shops and dining are within walking distance of the Coconut Plantation Marketplace. These apartments are the perfect starting point to explore the beauty of Kauai with Wailua Falls and Fern Grotto just a few minutes drive away.

The resort is the ultimate Kauai beachfront rental property, conveniently located yet absolutely private. The spacious 1- and 2-bedroom apartments are set on Wailua Bay on the island of Kauai. The complex has a total of 18 units and includes a lobby and parking facilities.

The roomy 1- or 2-bedroom Kauai condo rentals are individually furnished and feel like the islands. Each one of these gorgeous Kauai condo rentals comes with a full kitchen, wet bar, cable TV and VCR. There is no air conditioning but ceiling fans are provided. An en suite bathroom with hairdryer features, as does a direct dial telephone, radio, kitchen, fridge, cooker, microwave, tea/coffee making facilities and an ironing set. The balconies overlook the lush gardens and the sandy beachfront.

Guests are offered a variety of activities including snorkelling, diving, kayaking and sailing. Guests can also soak up the Hawaiian sun on the sundeck, walk to Plantation Marketplace for a bite to eat and some shopping, play golf at one of the many world-class golf courses in the area, or swim in the saltwater pool. A solarium also features. There is a barbeque area on site.

Exit the Lihue Airport and turn right at the first traffic signal onto Kapule Highway (Hwy)/Hwy 51. Continue on Hwy 51 until it intersects with Kuhio Hwy/Hwy 56. Continue on Kuhio Hwy/Hwy 56 as it crosses the Waialua River Bridge. Turn right before the Shell Service Station onto Papaloa Road. Turn right into the resort.

Description:
Built in the late 1860s the Inn was once home to the local plantation doctor and his family.  The home and the grounds still carry the vintage feel and the original architecture of old Hawaii.  Plantation era is about to come to an end here in the islands of Hawaii and Maui will be closing the last sugar plantation at the end of 2016.  

Haiku Inn, speaks of that era of missionary families, colonial homes, and plantation life.  We maintain the feeling for a reason, as there are very few locations in the state where you can see yet experience a home of this era.   

We are centrally located on the North Shore with a brief walk to restaurants, markets, shops and services. We lovingly restored the old home and continue to our stewardship daily.  Come experience the days of gone by, and the real meaning of Aloha and the Hawaiian spirit.  Rest and relax in an atmosphere of peace and calm, yet close to Paia, Makawao and the big surf beaches. All of Maui is easy access really and we are right off Hana Hwy.  We are about an hours drive to the summit for sunrise, minutes to bike tours, ziplines, horseback rides, sea turtle viewing and even waterfalls with swimming holes.  Mauis best! Nestled in the historic plantation town of Haiku, Hawaii, this charming guest house offers an on-site garden where guests can relax and enjoy fresh growing fruits. Free Wi-Fi is provided in the lobby.

Built in the 1870s for a pineapple plantation doctor, this historic home provides guest accommodations in a bed and breakfast setting. All rooms at Haiku Plantation Inn are furnished with an eclectic mix of antique pieces, Hawaiian quilts, and authentic Hawaiian art. Each room is equipped with an en suite bathroom.

The guest lounge area boasts tropically themed furnishings, travel guides and reading materials, a flat-screen TV, and an audio and video library. Guests can enjoy views of the garden and its century-old trees out on the spacious patio.

A complimentary continental breakfast consisting of a variety of selections such as baked goods and pastries, fresh fruits, cereals, yogurts, and jams is served daily. An all-day tea counter is also available for guests at Haiku Plantation Inn.

The surrounding countryside includes several attractions, such as cane fields, the last pineapple plantation, and organic farms. Hana Highway, which offers a scenic drive along the shore, is just a 2-minute drive from the guest house, and Haleakala National Park is a 45-minute drive. Kahului Airport is a 24-minute drive away. Description: The hotel is set on 11 lush hectares of land on the island of Maui in Hawaii. It offers two private beach coves. Complimentary coffee is served daily in the lobby. In addition, there is a weekly Polynesian show.

The Mana Kai Maui sits oceanfront on Keawakapu Beach (one of South Mauis best beaches).  Guests will enjoy walking along this beach all the way to the five star Wailea resorts.  Guests will also enjoy the oceanfront restaurant, The Five Palms, on the ground level, complete with full bar.  There is an onsite general store for snacks, a tour activity desk, and also a beach equipment rental office for renting kayaks, stand up paddle boards, and more!  There is great snorkeling right in front of the property. Set on the beachfront in Wailea and featuring an outdoor swimming pool, Mana Kai Maui has free WiFi throughout the property. All rooms feature a TV with cable channels and a private bathroom. Guests can enjoy sea views.

The units will provide guests with a microwave.

Guests at the hotel will be able to enjoy activities in and around Wailea, like cycling.

Cove Beach is 2.5 km from Mana Kai Maui, while Makena Landing Beach Park is 6 km away. Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
Please inform Mana Kai Maui in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.
Guests will receive a rental agreement, which must be signed and returned directly to the property prior to arrival. If the agreement is not received, the guest should contact the property management company at the number on the booking confirmation. 
Please note that only registered guests are allowed at the property.
Guests shall abide by the propertys policy. Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 8:00.
Guests must be 21 years or older to check in without a parent or official guardian.

HotelDescription#The hotel is located in the Makaha Valley, just a 3-minute drive from Makaha Beach, famous for surfing. Pearl Harbour is just a 45-minute drive away, while Dole Plantation is 50 minutes away and the Sea Life Park is around an hour from the hotel, which is approximately 45 minutes from Honolulu International Airport.

Nestled in the beautiful Makaha Valley, a tranquil tropical estate lies ready to be discovered. Spanning the rugged cliffs of the Waianae Mountains and Oahu's pristine western shore, the resort and golf club offers a landscape of quiet, unassuming splendour - complete with a spectacular 18-hole championship golf course. It's the perfect setting for a Hawaiian holiday or business retreat, featuring all the amenities needed to enjoy the simplest pleasures of life in paradise. Guests can enjoy the splendid surroundings of Makaha Valley, with magnificent views of the Waianae mountain range, valley and beautiful sunsets soaking into the blue Pacific. This is the paradise of Old Hawaii. It offers guests the choice of 173 guest rooms, as well as a wide range of amenities, including an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a hairdresser, a bar, a pub, a games room, a TV room, a restaurant, conference facilities, Internet access and room service. There is parking provided for those arriving by car.

All guest rooms feature their own lanai terrace, a fridge, air conditioning, a cable TV, a coffee maker and a hairdryer. An en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, a radio, an iron and ironing board, a double or king-size bed and individually adjustable heating also come as standard. All offer unique styles and designs such as vaulted, Polynesian-style ceilings with picturesque garden and mountain views and partial views of the ocean.
